svg.text: No black outline. The edge is drawn with light, emboss or glass; two make the drink the wink.
No outline: a rim of light on top, a
warm shade below, a deeper float.
One honey surface; the face presses
up and the features are carved in.
The face is a disc of Liquid Glass,
One eye winks while a little pint
The winking eye is a tiny martini,
